post.summary: Sign in with email and password (sets the session cookie)
post.description: Answers `authenticated`, or `mfa_required` when the account has two-step verification: then only POST /v1/auth/mfa/verify works with this session until the code is checked.

post.summary: Sign out (revokes the current session)
Second step of sign-in: authenticator code or recovery code
Change password (re-enter current password; signs out other sessions)
Request a password reset email
Set a new password with the token from the email (signs out everywhere)
Create an account (sends a verification email)
post.description: Always 202 with the same message, whether or not the address already has an account (FR-SEC-014).

post.summary: Send a new verification email
Re-verify (code, or password without two-step verification) before a sensitive action
Confirm an email address with the token from the email

get.summary: Readiness probe (503 when a dependency is down)

post.summary: Accept an invitation as the signed-in user (email must match)
Preview an invitation (public, minimal information)
Replace recovery codes (needs a recent step-up)
Confirm setup with a code; returns recovery codes once and signs out other sessions
Turn off two-step verification (password + current code)
Start authenticator-app setup (returns the secret and otpauth URI once)

get.summary: Your roles and permissions in an organization (for UI gating only)

post.summary: Sign out all your other sessions

delete.summary: Sign out one of your other sessions

post.summary: Create an organization (you become its owner)
Start an upload: checks type/size, returns the URL to PUT the bytes to

delete.summary: Delete a file (kept 30 days for recovery; refused while it is referenced)

get.summary: Stream the file through the API (authorized on every request)

put.summary: Send the file bytes (application/octet-stream); the file is then checked in the background

get.summary: Search the organization audit log (newest first, cursor paginated)

post.summary: Invite someone by email with a proposed role
Cancel a pending invitation
Resend with a new link (the old link stops working)

get.summary: Effective permissions of a member (yourself, or anyone with members.view)

post.summary: Reactivate a suspended member
Revoke a membership (kept as history)

put.summary: Replace the roles of a member (only roles you can delegate)

post.summary: Suspend a member
Transfer ownership to another active member (explicit confirmation required)

get.summary: Roles available in the organization, with permissions and whether you can assign them
Organization security policy (MFA requirement, step-up age, session limits)

put.summary: Change the security policy (new version; needs a recent step-up)
